acceptance_predicates.description: Every public route accepts --list and reports applicable discovery domains or an explicit empty result.
Every advertised selectable ID identifies the consuming command flag and is accepted by that flag.
Listing is bounded and side-effect free unless a separate explicit refresh action is selected.

definition_of_done: Human and JSON list contracts, selection round trips, independent review, and exact-head gates pass.

inputs.description: AR-1805 route inventory and existing typed catalogs.

outputs.description: Shared list/domain/selection behavior for all public commands.

gates.description: Every route/domain and advertised selection is mechanically verified.
